landing.headline: Tax optimisation
landing.subhead: Unveiling and enhancing opportunities — for greater tax efficiency
landing.lead: Tax planning and optimisation for companies — a legal way to reduce the tax burden.
landing.p1: People often look at tax optimisation with suspicion. Tax itself became a stigma: any cut in the bill is assumed to come from something murky and outside the law.
landing.p2: Tax work has long since moved from a purely reactive stance with the authorities to a proactive one: taking initiative and anticipating, then executing.
landing.p3: A professional approach, proper planning, and execution help your company use, legally, the benefits that apply to its situation. The public screen does not teach the method.

about.headline: Business tax, with execution.
about.p1: BeTaxed works with companies in Portugal. We find unrealized Social Security savings and, if you stay, we run the process with you.
about.p2: This is not a do-it-yourself calculator. The public screen shows totals; the map for how to get them stays with us.
